title: Retail Installment Contracts Calendar Note: Weekend Quote Dates on Payoff Statements
content:
A payoff statement on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts quoted at the end of the week adds anchor days so that its window counts from the following Monday:

| Quote date falls on | Anchor days added |
|---|---|
| Friday | **3** |
| Saturday | **2** |
| Sunday | **1** |
| Monday to Thursday | none |

**Finding the day of the week.** The day of the week is found as the whole days since Monday 5 January 2026 (2026-01-05), modulo seven: a remainder of 0 is Monday, 1 Tuesday, 2 Wednesday, 3 Thursday, 4 Friday, 5 Saturday and 6 Sunday.

**Worked dates.** 9 January 2026 is 4 days after 5 January 2026, remainder 4: a Friday, 3 days. 18 January 2026 is 13 days after, remainder 6: a Sunday, 1 day. 29 December 2025 is 7 days before 5 January 2026, remainder 0: a Monday, none.
